**Trust decision:** whether an outbound HTTPS Bearer-token notification validates the peer certificate and hostname — decided in `BitBucketPPRBearerAuthorizationApiConsumer.send`, which hands Apache HttpClient a trust-all `TrustStrategy` plus `NoopHostnameVerifier` (`...:61-74`); the fix swaps it for `HttpClients.createSystem()`.
**pattern_fit:** `injection_only` — the only trust-all client in the tree is the landing point; no second implementation, no uncovered route, and the other two diff hunks are exception-signature cleanup.
**Strongest lever:** O5 — private-CA/self-signed installs and JVM proxy settings must keep working via the JVM JSSE trust store, so a `createDefault()`/custom-client "fix" passes the cert test but quietly breaks them (`fix.diff:95-101`).
**Biggest red flag:** `single_site` (15-minute one-function security change; `tiny_repo` likely but unmeasured and left unflagged).
